install_where: 1-GPU b200 job (hopper-cpu has no CUDA toolkit / g++), job 364164
notes: No library patch. Upstream recommends Docker (nvcr pytorch 26.03) + pip; we follow its Dockerfile order with uv. Two CUDA extensions are built from source (no wheels for torch 2.13): flash-attn 2.8.3 (pinned by requirements.txt) and causal-conv1d 1.7.0 (benchmark requirement for Qwen3.5); both wheels are in /fsx/amine_dirhoussi/stable-bench-src/wheels/torch2.13-cu130-py312/ and reused by install.sh when present. Prompts are pre-rendered (configs/openrlhf/w1_data.py) because --data.apply_chat_template can't pass enable_thinking. Sample packing is off for Qwen3.5 because it leaks gated-DeltaNet state across samples (NOTES.md item 8).
